tickets.subject: Report builder question over the holidays
tickets.body: Small question while things are quiet - can report builder templates be shared across the whole team, or only within one user's account?

tickets.subject: Report builder template sharing - following up
tickets.body: Coming back to the template sharing question from December - a colleague had been pointing to Dashlume as an alternative that does this out of the box, but the shared template option you added recently covers what we needed. Just confirming the setup steps.

tickets.subject: Alerts not firing
tickets.body: Threshold alerts on the ops dashboard haven't fired since Friday even though the numbers clearly crossed the line. We rely on these.

tickets.subject: Alerts silent, confirming

tickets.subject: Dashboard tiles blank

tickets.subject: Alerts down during month-end
tickets.body: On top of the export issue, alerts have gone quiet again too. Bad timing, we're closing the books this week.

tickets.body: API throwing 500s again. This is becoming a pattern rather than an incident.

tickets.body: When I group by region in the report builder, the subtotals don't match the raw data. Tried different filter combinations for a week without luck, could use a hand.

tickets.subject: Connector sync delay
tickets.body: Salesforce connector sync is running about six hours late most nights lately. Not urgent but would like it looked at.

tickets.subject: Connector paused itself

tickets.body: Setting up a new connector to our ERP system and getting a mapping error on the customer ID field. Is there a guide for custom field mapping?

tickets.subject: Report builder template not saving styles

tickets.subject: Export missing columns

tickets.subject: New connector - pagination issue
tickets.body: Large connector pulls seem to stop after roughly 5,000 rows without error. Might be a pagination limit somewhere?

tickets.body: The weekly scheduled export to our shared drive hasn't landed the last two weeks. No error in the log that I can see. Can someone check the schedule config?

tickets.subject: Alert emails going to spam
tickets.body: Separate from the export issue still open, alert notification emails are landing in spam for half our team. Might need an SPF/DKIM check on your side.

tickets.subject: API pagination limit
tickets.body: Following on from the connector issue earlier this year, same pagination cap seems to apply on the API endpoint too, capping at 5,000 records per call.

tickets.subject: Seat reallocation across teams
tickets.body: We've reorganised two teams and need to move six seats between them without losing report ownership history. Is there a supported way to do this, or do we need to recreate the reports?

tickets.subject: Scheduled export format changed
tickets.body: Our scheduled export switched from XLSX to CSV after the last update without us changing anything. Can this be reverted, or is it now the default?

tickets.subject: Dashboard filter not persisting
tickets.body: When a user applies a date filter on the shared dashboard, it resets for everyone else viewing it at the same time. Would help if filters were per-viewer.

tickets.subject: Alert recipients list capped
tickets.body: Trying to add a ninth recipient to an alert rule and the field won't accept more than eight. Is that a hard limit?

tickets.subject: Seat count discrepancy after renewal
tickets.body: After renewing, the admin panel shows three unused seats we thought we'd removed months ago. Could you confirm our current licensed count?

tickets.subject: New user can't log in
tickets.body: Added a new seat this morning but the invited user isn't receiving the welcome email. Checked spam already.

tickets.subject: Export scheduling - timezone wrong
tickets.body: Our scheduled exports are firing at 2am local instead of the 8am we configured. Looks like it might be reading UTC instead of our account timezone.

tickets.subject: Alert not sent for breached threshold
tickets.body: Set up an alert for when weekly logins drop below 50 and it didn't fire this week despite the number clearly dropping. Can you check the rule configuration?

tickets.subject: API webhook not firing on schedule change
tickets.body: We expected a webhook event when a scheduled report's time changes, but nothing comes through. Is this supported currently?

tickets.subject: Alert digest email missing entries
tickets.body: The daily alert digest email only lists about half of the alerts that actually triggered yesterday. The rest just vanish.

tickets.subject: SSO login loop
tickets.body: Since enabling SSO for the finance group, three users get stuck in a redirect loop and can't get past login. IT has checked our side and it looks fine there.

tickets.subject: API rate limit increase request
tickets.body: Following up separately from the SSO issue Aino raised, could we get our API rate limit reviewed? We're hitting the ceiling during month-end batch jobs.

tickets.subject: Dashboard totals don't match ledger
tickets.body: The finance dashboard total is off by a small amount compared to our ledger export. Rounding somewhere, probably, but worth checking.

tickets.subject: Connector to accounting system keeps dropping
tickets.body: The connector to our accounting system disconnects every few days and I have to reauthorise it manually. Honestly at this point I've been tempted to just pull the numbers into Excel myself, which defeats the purpose of having this set up.

tickets.subject: Export missing negative values
tickets.body: Exported P&L report shows negative figures as blank cells instead of numbers in brackets. Formatting issue on export, I think.

tickets.subject: Still waiting on seat billing correction
tickets.body: Following up again on the seat count issue from earlier, we're still being billed for a seat we removed in March. Between this and the connector dropping constantly, half our finance team just does month-end in Excel now and skips the platform entirely.

tickets.subject: API sync failing intermittently
tickets.body: Our nightly API sync fails roughly one night in five with a generic timeout. No pattern we can find on our side.

tickets.subject: API timeout - still happening
tickets.body: Same intermittent timeout Kristina reported in June is still occurring, maybe slightly more often now.

tickets.subject: API sync - third occurrence
tickets.body: Third time reporting this API timeout since June. Would like an actual root cause this time rather than a retry suggestion.

tickets.subject: Report builder freezes on large datasets
tickets.body: Building a report against a dataset over roughly 200k rows and the builder just freezes the browser tab. Have to force-close and lose the work.

tickets.subject: Report builder - freeze still there
tickets.body: Coming back to the freezing issue Timo flagged last August, it's still happening on our larger datasets. We've just been avoiding building anything big in the tool since then.

tickets.subject: Bulk seat import
tickets.body: Is there a way to bulk-import users via CSV rather than adding them one at a time? We're onboarding a new department.

tickets.subject: Export file naming convention
tickets.body: Scheduled exports all save with the same generic filename, which overwrites previous versions in our archive folder. Could the filename include the date automatically?

tickets.subject: Export archive gap
tickets.body: Noticed a gap in our export archive around late January, a couple of scheduled runs seem to be missing entirely, no error logged.

tickets.subject: Alert rule duplicated after edit
tickets.body: Editing an existing alert rule created a duplicate instead of updating the original. Now we're getting doubled notifications.

tickets.subject: Seat removal not immediate
tickets.body: Removed a seat for a departed contractor but they still show as active a day later. Not urgent, just noting it takes longer than expected.

tickets.subject: Role permissions too broad
tickets.body: New finance seats default to full admin access rather than the viewer role we need. Is there a way to set a default role for new invites?

tickets.subject: API documentation outdated
tickets.body: The API docs reference an endpoint for bulk report retrieval that returns a 404. Has it been renamed or deprecated?

tickets.subject: API auth token format changed?
tickets.body: Our integration broke over the new year, token format seems to have changed without a changelog note we could find.

tickets.subject: Can't demote admin to viewer
tickets.body: Trying to change a user from Admin to Viewer role and the change doesn't stick after saving.

tickets.subject: Seat invite email delayed
tickets.body: New seat invite took almost two days to arrive in the recipient's inbox. Nothing in spam, just slow.

tickets.subject: Export button greyed out
tickets.body: Export button on the quarterly report is greyed out for one user but works fine for the rest of the team on the same permission level.

tickets.subject: Bulk seat import for new hires
tickets.body: We have six new starters joining across two weeks in March and would like to add their seats in bulk rather than one at a time. Is there a CSV import option for provisioning users, or a way to at least pre-set their role/permissions template before they receive their invite? Would save us a fair bit of manual setup. Anna

tickets.subject: Dashboard filters not carrying over on share
tickets.body: When I apply a filter to a dashboard and then share the link with a colleague, they see the unfiltered version rather than the filtered view I intended, forcing them to reapply it themselves or ask me for a screenshot instead. For now I've just been exporting the filtered view to Excel and sending that directly, which works but defeats the point of sharing a live dashboard. Could this be looked at? Anna

tickets.subject: Still exporting to Excel instead of sharing dashboards
tickets.body: Following up on the filter-sharing issue from May — it's still behaving the same way, filtered views not carrying over on shared links, so we've just continued with the Excel export workaround in the meantime. It does the job for now, so there's no need to treat this as pressing, but wanted to note that the fix from a couple of months ago doesn't seem to have taken hold. Anna

tickets.subject: Setting up department-level access groups
tickets.body:
We are restructuring our team access ahead of Q4. Planning to create four groups (Sales, Finance, Operations, and IT) with different dashboard permissions for each. Can I nest groups, or is it flat group membership only? Also, if a user is in two groups with conflicting permissions, which takes precedence?

Sigrid Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Export scheduling - monthly option?
tickets.body: Quick one, could we get a monthly (not just weekly/daily) option for scheduled exports? Would save us a manual step every month-end. Loving the platform otherwise.

tickets.subject: New connector for HubSpot?
tickets.body: Any plans to add a native HubSpot connector? We're currently routing through a workaround and it'd be great to have it built in.

tickets.subject: Dashboard sharing with external clients
tickets.body: Would like to share a read-only dashboard link with an external client without giving them a full seat. Is that on the roadmap?

tickets.subject: Feature request - seat groups
tickets.body: Managing individual seats one by one gets tedious as we grow. Would love to see a groups feature so we can assign permissions in bulk. Not urgent, just a wish list item.

tickets.subject: Dashboard commenting feature?
tickets.body: Following up on our roadmap conversation, any update on whether inline commenting on dashboard tiles is planned? Would help our team discuss numbers directly instead of over email.

tickets.subject: Custom export templates
tickets.body: Small ask: could saved export templates include our logo automatically? Right now we add it by hand every time.

tickets.subject: Dashboard performance - noticeably faster
tickets.body: Just wanted to flag that dashboard load times have improved a lot since the last update. Whatever you changed, it's working.

tickets.subject: Report builder - new grouping options great
tickets.body: The new grouping options in report builder are exactly what we asked for a while back. Nice to see it shipped.

tickets.subject: Alert not linked to correct dashboard
tickets.body: Created an alert meant to track the sales dashboard but it's pulling numbers from an old archived version instead.

tickets.subject: Connector auth expired without warning
tickets.body: Connector to our CRM stopped syncing and it turns out the auth had quietly expired. Would be good to get a warning before it lapses.

tickets.subject: Dashboard won't load on mobile
tickets.body: The shared dashboard link works fine on desktop but just shows a blank page on mobile browsers. Tried two different phones.

tickets.subject: Setting up access structure for large team
tickets.body:
We are configuring the platform for a team of approximately 80 users across four departments. Looking for guidance on the recommended approach: is it better to use role-based access with department-specific roles, or to rely on sharing at the dashboard and report level? We want to avoid over-permissioning but also don't want to create an admin burden.

Ville Mäkinen
IT Manager

tickets.subject: Initial connector setup — multiple sources failing
tickets.body:
Setting up data connectors for the first time. Out of five sources I am trying to connect, three are failing at the authentication step. The two that work are our SQL Server instances. The three failing are Salesforce, Google BigQuery, and a REST API connector. For each I have verified the credentials are correct. Is there any known setup issue with these connector types that I should check?

Nils Larsson
Data Engineer

tickets.subject: Dashboard rendering inconsistent across users
tickets.body:
We have now onboarded around 50 of our 80 planned users. I am seeing reports from multiple users of dashboards not loading or loading with stale data. The issues are not consistent — the same dashboard loads fine for some users and not for others at the same time. Could this be a regional caching issue? Our users are split across three office locations.

Ville Mäkinen

tickets.subject: Report builder broken — cannot open any report
tickets.body:
Report builder is completely broken this morning. Clicking on any report just shows a blank screen. Not loading, just blank. This is affecting the whole team. What happened?

Nils Larsson

tickets.subject: Export queue backed up — jobs waiting hours
tickets.body:
We have four export jobs that have been sitting in the queue for over three hours. Normally they run within minutes. This is the second time in a week the export queue has seized up. Our finance team is waiting on this data for their monthly close. Is there a known capacity issue with the export infrastructure?

Ville Mäkinen

tickets.subject: Alerts module — bulk configuration broken
tickets.body:
Trying to update alert thresholds across 12 alerts using the bulk edit feature. The UI accepts the changes and shows a success message but none of the thresholds are actually updated when I check individually. Have to do it one by one as a workaround. The bulk edit feature is essentially non-functional.

Nils Larsson

tickets.subject: API degraded — failures across all endpoints
tickets.body:
We are seeing widespread API failures starting this morning. Approximately 30% of calls are returning 503 errors across multiple endpoints. Our data pipeline runs on this API and is currently producing incomplete output. This is the third significant reliability issue in the past month.

I want to be clear: we are an Enterprise customer and this level of instability is not acceptable. If this continues, the business case for staying on this platform becomes very hard to defend internally. Please escalate to engineering immediately and provide a timeline for resolution.

Ville Mäkinen
IT Manager

tickets.subject: Report builder performance unacceptable for complex reports
tickets.body:
Reports with more than about 10 calculated fields now take 3-5 minutes to render. This was not the case three months ago. We have not changed the reports. Whatever was deployed in the last quarter has significantly degraded performance for complex report builder configurations. This is affecting daily work for at least 15 of our users.

Nils Larsson
